rules.statement: In this run, accepting all cookies dismissed the initial banner and it stayed absent across subsequent pages.
preconditions: Initial home banner present
branches: Accept All Cookies clicked; banner absent

rules.statement: The untouched rendered login form submitted successfully (POST response ok=true), returned home, and later showed an Account button with Collection, Wantlist and Sign out. The initial prediction of an empty-form rejection was contradicted; untouched is not evidence that the fields were empty.
preconditions: First observed login form in this run; no fields cleared
branches: Click Sign in -> home; authenticated menu subsequently available
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer arbitrary credentials accepted

rules.statement: For release 221 under this account, adding to Wantlist twice returned ok=true twice. Sidebar Want changed 3→4→5 while the static main count stayed 3; a fresh page showed 4 and the wantlist had one target card. A duplicate add did not produce a second persisted membership in these readbacks.
preconditions: Authenticated account; release221 initially absent from own wantlist
branches: Second add increased optimistic sidebar only
forbidden_side_effects: Do not equate optimistic counter increment with a new persisted record

rules.statement: For release221, Collection and Wantlist coexist. Collection first add raised Have 2→3 and displayed the release in own collection. A later repeated collection add showed 4 locally, then 3 on fresh navigation.
preconditions: Authenticated supplied account; release221
branches: Repeated add did not increase reloaded count

rules.statement: On observed marketplace221, Add to Cart is a link rather than a button. Its first own-seller link had href /cart?add=4; clicking it produced a persisted cart item for listing4 at USD21.45. Own-seller purchase eligibility was therefore not blocked at this add step.
preconditions: Authenticated; listing4 active at time of observation
branches: Link navigation added item and normalized URL to /cart
forbidden_side_effects: Do not treat add-link navigation as read-only

rules.statement: Repeating the confirmed add for listing4 increased its cart quantity 1→2 and total2145→4290 cents, although only one row and unchanged unit price were displayed. Adding listing7 made a separate row and total6575 cents. The original idempotent-cart prediction is refuted.
preconditions: Authenticated; observed listing4 and listing7 active
forbidden_side_effects: Do not blindly repeat cart adds or infer quantity from row count

rules.statement: One checkout with listing4 quantity2 and listing7 quantity1 cleared the cart to total0. Subsequent marketplace221 count fell25→23; own listing4 became sold despite its seller quantity1. Response details and visible effects are the evidence; total hidden record effects and general stock policy remain unknown. The naturally caused checkout response identified order121, status paid, total6575 cents, with listing4 quantity2 and listing7 quantity1. This establishes that response, not complete hidden accounting.
preconditions: Observed cart6575 cents; supplied authenticated account
branches: Checkout accepted; cart emptied; two listings left active marketplace
forbidden_side_effects: Do not infer complete order accounting or universal oversell acceptance

rules.statement: After checkout on marketplace221, Ships From=US plus Apply returned four US rows. Adding Minimum Rating=99 returned none. Clearing country and choosing price_desc with rating99 returned two Sweden rows at72.51 then44.91. Filling controls alone had not refreshed the rows before Apply.
preconditions: Observed23 active listings after checkout
branches: Apply updates URL query and listing count

rules.statement: Media Condition=Mint returned zero rows for marketplace221, whereas Mint (M) returned five exact-condition rows. Adding min_rating101 returned no matches. This supports exact-label matching for those two tested condition strings, not every field or case.
preconditions: Marketplace221 observed23 active listings

rules.statement: On /sell, Create Listing was disabled before selecting a release. Searching Dark Side returned release221 and automatically showed it as Selected; with default positive price creation became enabled. The disabled click timed out before activation, so it provides no backend rejection evidence.
preconditions: Authenticated fresh /sell form
branches: Unique search result -> selected and enabled
forbidden_side_effects: Do not force disabled controls or infer backend absence

rules.statement: With selected221, price0 disabled Create Listing; quantity0 alone with positive price remained enabled. Submitting quantity0 with default other values returned HTTP422 with quantity >=1 validation shown in UI. No new listing appeared in that rejection readback.
preconditions: Authenticated /sell; release221 selected; otherwise default valid fields
branches: Quantity0 submitted and rejected by server

rules.statement: Creating release221 with quantity2, price1234 cents and default conditions/country produced listing640 active at USD12.34. It persisted on navigation and appeared first in ascending marketplace. Deactivate changed640 to inactive; repeating confirmed deactivate returned ok and retained inactive; it was absent from active marketplace afterward.

branches: Deactivate retains own record with inactive status
